header.rule: Players turn cards over in turn, and whoever calls first when a card matches the one before it takes the whole pile. The trigger is not fixed -- it is always a comparison with the previous card, so nothing can be called while a single card is showing. Calling wrongly costs you a card from your stock, face up onto the pile.

tutorial.rule: Players turn cards over in turn, and whoever calls first when a card **matches the one before it** takes the pile. **The trigger is not fixed** -- it is always a comparison with the previous card.
tutorial.single: **A single card showing can never be snapped**: there is nothing to match it against. Pressing early costs you.
tutorial.penalty: Calling wrongly **puts one of your own cards face up on the pile**, which makes the pile worth more to whoever takes it next.
tutorial.stock: A seat with no stock left is skipped, and **collecting every card wins**. How fast the CPUs react is a setting.
